title: What's the time?
description: A bilingual lesson about telling the time (o'clock, quarter, half past) and asking about birthdays and ages, with 12 numbered clocks, a July calendar and four 'enjoy' pictures. Includes workbook preposition, situation and personal-answer practice, plus grammar on dates, alternative time-telling and at/in/on. 关于报时（整点、一刻、半点）以及询问生日和年龄的双语课，配12幅编号时钟、7月日历和4幅 enjoy 插图。配合教材介词、情景和自答练习，以及日期、另一种报时方式和 at/in/on 的语法练习。
answer_note: Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 66 key (img/key-063-067.jpg); practice B situation answers and practice C personal answers are constructed from the printed word bank and prompts and labelled suggested. Textbook written-exercise answers are constructed from the printed examples and labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 66 grammar key (PDF viewer page 498). No external sources were used.

lesson.title: Written exercise A Complete these sentences using in, at or from.
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences using in, at or from. 用 in, at 或 from 完成以下句子。
lesson.translation: Complete each sentence with in, at or from.
lesson.context: Item 3 has two blanks (one answer field with both words); item 6 has two blanks (one answer field with both words). No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from standard English usage and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: I am going to see him ______ ten o'clock.
Where do you come ______? I come ______ France.
I always go to work ______ the morning.
What's the climate like ______ your country?
It's cold ______ winter and hot ______ summer.

lesson.title: Written exercise B Answer these questions.
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions using I/you/he/she/we/they and ... o'clock, a quarter to ... past ..., half past .... 模仿例句回答问题。
lesson.translation: Answer each question following the example pattern.
lesson.context: The printed example shows 'When must you come home? (1.00) → I must come home at one o'clock.' Items 1-11 follow the same pattern with the given time. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

questions.answer: I must come home at one o'clock.

questions.prompt: When must she go to the library? (1.15)
questions.answer: She must go to the library at a quarter past one.

questions.prompt: When must you and Sam see the dentist? (3.45)
questions.answer: We must see the dentist at a quarter to four.

questions.prompt: When must you type this letter? (2.00)
questions.answer: I must type this letter at two o'clock.

questions.prompt: When must Sam and Penny see the boss? (1.30)
questions.answer: They must see the boss at half past one.

questions.prompt: When must George take his medicine? (3.15)
questions.answer: He must take his medicine at a quarter past three.

questions.prompt: When must Sophie arrive in London? (2.30)
questions.answer: She must arrive in London at half past two.

questions.prompt: When must I catch the bus? (3.30)
questions.answer: You must catch the bus at half past three.
I must arrive there at three o'clock.
They must come home at a quarter past two.
I must meet Sam at a quarter to two.
He must telephone you at a quarter to three.

practice.title: A Prepositions
practice.instruction: Write these words in the correct box with at or in. 将以下词和短语列入正确的介词栏中。
practice.translation: Sort each phrase into the 'at' or 'in' column, following the printed examples.
practice.context: The printed examples 'at six o'clock' and 'in July' are not editable. The remaining 8 phrases are each one answer field: 'at' or 'in'.

practice.title: B Situations
practice.instruction: What questions do you ask in these situations? 写出适合以下情景的问句。
practice.translation: For each situation, write the appropriate question.
practice.context: The printed word bank (six o'clock, July, the afternoon, night, the evening, March, half past six, a quarter past ten, the morning, summer, a quarter to three, autumn, half past five, September) is the source material. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the prompts and labelled suggested.

practice.instruction: Write complete answers to these questions. 用完整的句子回答以下问题。
